headline: GPT-6 Astra agents show improved efficiency with fewer tokens required
body: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra model demonstrates a 14% higher success rate while consuming 65% fewer tokens than previous iterations, according to multiple technical reports. This efficiency gain directly impacts healthcare AI economics: lower token consumption reduces computational costs for clinical documentation, real-time clinical decision support, and EHR integration tasks. For healthcare systems evaluating large language model vendors, token efficiency translates to sustainable economics in value-based care environments where AI operational costs directly affect margins. Consulting engagements around LLM deployment should factor this efficiency metric when modeling total cost of ownership for clinical AI workflows.
